independence_rule: one strongest row per code and direction; same study shares independence_group
rationale: Mutant/complementation or equivalent direct genetic tests receive the highest assay-priority tier.

independence_rule: one strongest row per code and direction; require stable publication/database source
rationale: A previously established QTG is strong prior evidence but is below a direct test in the current genetic background.

independence_rule: one strongest row; do not split orthology and source phenotype into independent votes
rationale: A phenotype-tested ortholog supports function across species but remains vulnerable to divergence and paralogy.

independence_rule: all position codes are one family
rationale: Recombinant localization narrows the locus but does not identify the causal gene by itself.

independence_rule: all position codes are one family
rationale: Overlap with an explicit QTL peak prioritizes assays while retaining mapping uncertainty.

independence_rule: all position codes are one family; only explicit uncertainty windows score
rationale: Proximity scores only when the analyst supplies a peak uncertainty window.

independence_rule: all position codes are one family
rationale: A formal support interval is useful context but weak gene-level discrimination.

independence_rule: all comparative annotations from one analysis chain share one family
rationale: Reciprocal best-hit evidence is a computational orthology hypothesis and not phenotype proof.

independence_rule: all comparative annotations from one source chain share one family
rationale: A curated homolog with trait-specific source is stronger than generic similarity but remains indirect.

independence_rule: all automated homolog and annotation rows share one comparative-function family
rationale: A phenotype-derived API/LLM panel with stable sources is useful for screening but weaker than a reviewed curated homolog.

independence_rule: all automated orthology and function retrieval rows share one comparative-function family
rationale: At low confidence this contributes 0.625: enough to outrank generic orthogroup context, but below a medium-confidence curated homolog. It remains unreviewed screening evidence.

independence_rule: combine with orthology from the same chain
rationale: Conserved genomic context improves orthology confidence but does not independently establish trait function.

independence_rule: all expression contrasts from one experiment share one family
rationale: Target-specific expression is functional consistency evidence, not a causal test.

independence_rule: all comparative annotations from one analysis chain share one family
rationale: Orthogroup membership supports a gene-family hypothesis but may include paralogs.

independence_rule: must have trait-specific interpretation; generic domains are context
rationale: A trait-relevant domain can support function only with an explicit trait link.

independence_rule: annotation and homology from the same source chain share one family
rationale: Controlled trait-term matching is a reading aid and weak functional hypothesis.

independence_rule: all comparative annotations from one analysis chain share one family
rationale: Near-tied paralogs weaken simple one-hit functional transfer.

independence_rule: one strongest row per code and direction; preserve conflicting support
rationale: Strong source-backed contradiction must remain visible and can outweigh weak annotation support.

independence_rule: all expression contrasts from one experiment share one family
rationale: Reliable absence in the relevant tissue weakens candidacy modestly because timing and detection limits remain.

independence_rule: legacy only; all comparative annotations share one family
rationale: Legacy generic homology is retained at minimal weight; new generic similarity must be context-only.

independence_rule: all expression observations from one experiment share one family
rationale: Detection without a relevant comparison is weak permissive context.

independence_rule: all position codes are one family
rationale: QTL boundary proximity is recorded for audit and never scores.

independence_rule: all comparative annotations from one analysis chain share one family
rationale: Generic sequence similarity records conservation only and has no positive weight.

independence_rule: all comparative annotations from one analysis chain share one family
rationale: Generic domain presence without trait specificity has no positive weight.

independence_rule: all comparative annotations from one analysis chain share one family
rationale: GO annotations require evidence codes and references; generic presence alone does not score.

independence_rule: controlled broad terms never score
rationale: Broad phenotype words are context and cannot create trait support.

independence_rule: all position codes are one family
rationale: Membership defines candidate scope and is not evidence for one gene over another.

independence_rule: all position codes are one family
rationale: An inferred window is reported but cannot substitute for mapping uncertainty supplied by the study.

independence_rule: all expression observations from one experiment share one family
rationale: Missing background comparison blocks specificity claims and does not score.

independence_rule: one rescue flag per reference annotation
rationale: Incomplete models trigger rescue analysis rather than negative scoring.

independence_rule: SnpEff and VEP on one VCF share one analysis chain
rationale: Predicted consequence is an annotation hypothesis until the parental genotype is confirmed; tool agreement does not score.

independence_rule: callers sharing a sample or alignment chain are one robustness group
rationale: SV/PAV overlap is a mechanistic hypothesis; QTL membership and caller agreement alone never score.
